title: Western Springs Pumping Station

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation at the south approach in the signed map frame.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped common south wall and north-side step constrain the 25.9 m connected envelope. The deeper eastern volume is the two-storey engine house. The western volume is the single-storey boiler wing.

note: The heritage records identify red brick, dressed basalt quoins and openings, round-arched multi-pane windows, cornices, entrance steps, hipped roofs, and broad arched boiler-house doorways.
